issues.detail: No <meta name="viewport"> — phones render the page at ~980px and zoom out.

Page is 1624px wide on a 1440px viewport — horizontal scroll. Widest offenders: div.wrap > div.reveal:nth-child(1) > img.shot:nth-child(1) (1600px wide, +184px past edge); header.wrap.hero > div.orb.b:nth-child(2) (260px wide, +80px past edge)
issues.fix: Fix the root cause: fixed px widths → min()/clamp()/%, grid columns → minmax(0,1fr), images max-width:100%, nowrap headings → wrap or clamp(). overflow-x:clip on html is the LAST resort.

issues.detail: 5 unconditional CSS rule(s) set width/min-width > 430px: .wrap { width:1200px }, #scene { width:560px }, .panel { width:720px }, .shot { width:1600px }, video { width:1152px }
issues.fix: Replace with width:min(1200px,100%) or max-width + width:100%; use clamp() for fluid sizes.

issues.detail: No @media (min/max-width) rules anywhere — layout cannot adapt.
issues.fix: Author mobile-first and add breakpoints where the content breaks (not device sizes).

issues.detail: font-size 12px — iOS Safari auto-zooms the page on focus.
issues.fix: Set inputs to font-size:16px (or 1rem) and add inputmode/enterkeyhint/autocomplete.

issues.detail: 6 interactive element(s) smaller than 44×44: nav > div.wrap:nth-child(1) > ul:nth-child(2) > li:nth-child(1) > a:nth-child(1) 50×18; nav > div.wrap:nth-child(1) > ul:nth-child(2) > li:nth-child(2) > a:nth-child(1) 45×18; nav > div.wrap:nth-child(1) > ul:nth-child(2) > li:nth-child(3) > a:nth-child(1) 32×18; nav > div.wrap:nth-child(1) > ul:nth-child(2) > li:nth-child(4) > button.icon-btn:nth-child(1) 24×24; nav > div.wrap:nth-child(1) > ul:nth-child(2) > li:nth-child(5) > button.icon-btn:nth-child(1) 24×24; #start > div:nth-child(1) > form:nth-child(2) > button:nth-child(2) 88×30
issues.fix: Give controls min-height:44px / min-width:44px via padding; for icon buttons keep the glyph small and enlarge the hit area with padding or a ::before pseudo-element.

issues.detail: 2 :hover rule(s) reveal/hide content outside @media (hover:hover): nav li:hover .menu → display; .card:hover .more → opacity. Touch devices have no hover — content is unreachable or sticks after tap.
issues.fix: Wrap decorative hover in @media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine). Hover-revealed menus/tooltips need a tap toggle (aria-expanded) or must be visible by default on touch.

issues.detail: autoplay without muted (blocked on iOS/Android); no playsinline (iOS opens full-screen player); no poster
issues.fix: <video autoplay muted playsinline loop poster="…" preload="metadata">

issues.detail: Canvas backing store is 1680×1680 for a 560×560 CSS box (ratio 3.00, device DPR 3) — Three.js renders 9× the pixels a phone can show.
issues.fix: renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(devicePixelRatio, 2)) — 1.5 on pointer:coarse or hardwareConcurrency<=4; size the canvas from its container with ResizeObserver.

issues.detail: 12 text element(s) under 12px: nav > div.wrap:nth-child(1) > ul:nth-child(2) > li:nth-child(4) > button.icon-btn:nth-child(1) 11px; nav > div.wrap:nth-child(1) > ul:nth-child(2) > li:nth-child(5) > button.icon-btn:nth-child(1) 11px; header.wrap.hero > div:nth-child(3) > span.mono:nth-child(1) 11px; section.wrap.features > div.card:nth-child(1) > span.n:nth-child(1) 11px; section.wrap.features > div.card:nth-child(2) > span.n:nth-child(1) 11px
issues.fix: Minimum 12px for labels/captions, 16px for body copy on phones.

issues.detail: 3 rule(s) use 100vh: .hero { height:100vh }; .gallery { height:100vh }; .gallery .rail { height:100vh }. On mobile Safari/Chrome 100vh is taller than the visible area while the URL bar shows, so content hides behind the bar and layouts jump.
issues.fix: Use height:100svh (or 100dvh for pinned/full-screen) with a 100vh fallback line before it.

issues.detail: 1 fixed bottom bar(s) and no env(safe-area-inset-*) anywhere in CSS — the home indicator overlaps them on iPhone.
issues.fix: padding-bottom: calc(12px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)); plus viewport-fit=cover in the meta.

issues.detail: 1 large image(s) (>1200px) served without srcset: div.wrap > div.reveal:nth-child(1) > img.shot:nth-child(1) 1600px — phones download desktop bytes.
issues.fix: Add srcset + sizes (or <picture>), loading="lazy" below the fold, decoding="async".

issues.detail: Animations present (GSAP, ScrollTrigger, Three.js) but nothing honours prefers-reduced-motion.
issues.fix: gsap.matchMedia() with "(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)" → duration 0 / static state; CSS: @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}}.

issues.detail: body font-size 15px — readable but tight on phones
4 images lack width/height attributes — layout shift while loading.
issues.fix: Add intrinsic width/height attributes (CSS can still set max-width:100%; height:auto).

issues.detail: 1 pinned section(s); ScrollTrigger mobile config not detected (ignoreMobileResize / normalizeScroll).
issues.fix: ScrollTrigger.config({ ignoreMobileResize:true }); consider ScrollTrigger.normalizeScroll(true) for pinned scrub on iOS.
